signal: EliseAI raised a $250M Series E at a $2.2B valuation and now automates workflows for property managers overseeing one in six US rental units

email.body1:
Maxwell, saw EliseAI close the $250M Series E at a $2.2B valuation, now touching one in six US rental units.

At that scale the follow-up volume on every account explodes, and as an SDR you can only personalize so many before research and writing eat the day. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so output scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to three of your top target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through them?
email.body2:
Maxwell, quick follow-up on your EliseAI outreach.

The hardest part of the SDR seat is response speed: signals fire, but by the time you research and write each touch, the window has already cooled. Tighter, faster, more personalized follow-up is where reply rates actually start to move for a rep in your seat.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I'd change, and our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Maxwell, last bit of proof.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to SDRs at other venture-backed startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Maxwell, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If speeding up follow-up and cutting research time isn't a focus this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and the EliseAI growth pace keeps an SDR's calendar full.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an SDR seat? I'll tailor it to your accounts either way.
